description: Create a database in a Data Catalog catalog. The database name is appended to location as a sub-path (location 's3a://mybucket' + name 'mydatabase' → 's3a://mybucket/mydatabase'). Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the database

location.description: Database location path, max 1000 chars (e.g. 's3a://mybucket'). The name is appended as a sub-path

name.description: Database name (1-128 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'_'/'-'/spaces only — pattern [a-z0-9_\-\s]+)

tagKeyTypeValueList.description: Tags to attach to the database

name: ncloud_datacatalog_create_database
